credentialGuide.title: Credential type guide
credentialGuide.description: Credential types are templates for common sensitive-data structures and help you choose the right fields. When unsure, choose the closest match; use Generic Secret only when the other types do not fit.
credentialGuide.createHint: Choose this when the target system requires a username and password
credentialGuide.tokenHint: Choose this when the target system provides a Token string
credentialGuide.accessKeyHint: Choose this when the target system provides a pair such as AK/SK or AccessKey ID/Secret
credentialGuide.secretHint: A fallback when the first three types do not fit; keeps it distinct from Access Key

password.scenarios: Databases, SSH, FTP/SFTP, HTTP Basic and device logins

token.scenarios: API Tokens, Bearer Tokens, PATs and Webhook Tokens

access_key.scenarios: Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Tencent Cloud, object storage and cloud API request signing

secret.fields: value (for api_key, client_secret, signing_secret, private_key and similar values)
secret.scenarios: Third-party API keys, OAuth client secrets, signing keys and encryption keys

credentials.metadataNotice: Only Credential metadata is shown here; secret values are never echoed to the browser.
credentials.name: Credential name
credentials.updateHint: Updating re-encrypts and replaces the saved value; required fields cannot be blank.
credentials.createRefreshFailed: {{operation}}, but the list refresh failed. Refresh manually to confirm and avoid submitting again.
credentials.deleteRefreshFailed: Credential deleted, but the list refresh failed. Refresh manually to confirm.

bindings.help: The code Credential name lets the script read the bound sensitive value, for example
bindings.helpSuffix: ; the field is injected into the Adapter execution environment as
bindings.injectedSuffix: ; all bindings are replaced on save.
bindings.openSettingsHint: To add a Credential, open System Settings → Credentials.
bindings.ownerRisk: Bindings show only Credential names and fields; Secret values are never shown. Owners can change bindings, so bind only trusted Credentials.
bindings.editRisk: This Adapter has bound Credentials. Editors can use them through code and execution, but can never read Secret values; grant Edit only to trusted users.
bindings.renameHint: After changing a code Credential name, update the references in the code too.
bindings.validationEnvKeyRequired: Every binding must have a code Credential name
bindings.validationEnvKeyDuplicate: Code Credential names must be unique
bindings.validationSelectionRequired: Every binding must select a Credential and field

packageSources.description: There can be at most one default source per type; the Worker tries its local cache first and then the default source for the language.
packageSources.nameAndUrlRequired: Package source name and index URL are required
packageSources.name: Package source name
packageSources.defaultCheckbox: Set as the default source for this type
packageSources.setDefault: {{name}} is now the default package source
packageSources.createRefreshFailed: Package source created, but the list refresh failed. Refresh manually to confirm and avoid submitting again.
packageSources.deleteRefreshFailed: Package source deleted, but the list refresh failed. Refresh manually to confirm.
packageSources.setDefaultRefreshFailed: {{name}} is now the default package source, but the list refresh failed. Refresh manually to confirm.
packageSources.restoreDefaultRefreshFailed: {{kind}} default package sources restored, but the list refresh failed. Refresh manually to confirm.
packageSources.emptyDefaults: Default package source information is not loaded. Refresh and try again.
packageSources.restoreConfirm: Restore {{name}} ({{url}}) as the default {{kind}} package source? This adds domestic and official defaults and selects the domestic source; existing custom sources and Credential bindings are preserved.
packageSources.fallbackNotice: No default {{kind}} source is configured: the Worker will use only its local cache, and installation will fail explicitly when the cache is insufficient. It will not silently use an unconfigured URL. Click “Restore default {{kind}}” above or create and set a default.
packageSources.testDetailUnknown: Check the URL, Credential and network

knowledgeSources.description: Configure a read-only knowledge source and verify the knowledge bases it can access. Tencent ima is supported first.
knowledgeSources.credentialNotice: Only the existing Credential reference is saved here; Client ID, API Key and other Secret values are never shown or echoed.
knowledgeSources.endpointNotice: The Tencent ima official address is used by default. A custom address is allowed only through the deployment environment variable DLR_IMA_ENDPOINT.
knowledgeSources.test: Test connection and list knowledge bases
knowledgeSources.testSucceeded: Connection validated; accessible knowledge bases refreshed
knowledgeSources.testFailed: Connection validation failed. Check the Credential and deployment network.
knowledgeSources.noKnowledgeBases: No knowledge bases listed yet. Test the connection first.
